author: Assassino4ever
body:
I just talked to ManCityForever and he told me everything. First you told him that you won't ban him unless he posts another unban appeal and he just asked you a question and you straight away banned him, so that is reason one that you shouldn't be a mod.
Reason number 2 is that you don't believe that he is my cousin do you have any evidence that he isn't my cousin? No. And if you count the fact that he said 'sorry for ban evading' is not an evidence. As I say both of us are from the Middle East and our primary language is Arabic so I will be honest I don't know what ban evading means and he told me that he guessed that it means you tell a staff to unban a friend/someone you know.
Last reason is because you haven't warned him that he will banned forever if he continues wanting me to be unbanned.
Proof that we are not the same person: Check the date we joined and all that jazz.
